func commandShow(repo *Repository, name string, before, after []string, ignoreContext bool) int {
	beforeIDs, _ := splitLeadingInts(before)
	afterIDs, rest := splitLeadingInts(after)
	ids := append(beforeIDs, afterIDs...)
	query := parseFilter(rest)
	query.IgnoreContext = ignoreContext

	var selected []*Task
	switch name {
	case "next", "show-open":
		selected = tasksByStatuses(repo.Tasks, "pending", "active", "paused")
	case "show-active":
		selected = tasksByStatuses(repo.Tasks, "active")
	case "show-paused":
		selected = tasksByStatuses(repo.Tasks, "paused")
	case "show-resolved":
		selected = tasksByStatuses(repo.Tasks, "resolved")
	case "show-templates":
		selected = tasksByStatuses(repo.Tasks, "template")
	case "show-unorganised":
		selected = tasksByStatuses(repo.Tasks, "pending", "active", "paused")
		filtered := make([]*Task, 0, len(selected))
		for _, task := range selected {
			if len(task.Tags) == 0 && task.Project == "" {
				filtered = append(filtered, task)
			}
		}
		selected = filtered
		ignoreContext = true
	}
	if len(ids) > 0 {
		selected = filterByIDs(selected, ids, true)
	}
	selected = applyContextAndFilter(repo, selected, query, !ignoreContext)
	sortTasksForView(selected, name)
	return renderTasks(repo, selected, name)
}

func commandShowTags(repo *Repository) int {
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	type item struct {
		tag     string
		created time.Time
	}
	var items []item
	for _, task := range repo.Tasks {
		for _, tag := range task.Tags {
			if seen[tag] {
				continue
			}
			seen[tag] = true
			items = append(items, item{tag: tag, created: task.Created})
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(items, func(i, j int) bool {
		if !items[i].created.Equal(items[j].created) {
			return items[i].created.Before(items[j].created)
		}
		return items[i].tag < items[j].tag
	})
	for _, item := range items {
		fmt.Println(item.tag)
	}
	return 0
}

func commandShowProjects(repo *Repository) int {
	type agg struct {
		name          string
		taskCount     int
		resolvedCount int
		active        bool
		created       time.Time
		resolved      time.Time
		priority      string
	}
	projects := map[string]*agg{}
	for _, task := range repo.Tasks {
		if task.Project == "" {
			continue
		}
		current := projects[task.Project]
		if current == nil {
			current = &agg{name: task.Project, created: task.Created, priority: task.Priority}
			projects[task.Project] = current
		}
		if task.Created.Before(current.created) {
			current.created = task.Created
		}
		if priorityRank(task.Priority) < priorityRank(current.priority) {
			current.priority = task.Priority
		}
		if task.Status == "resolved" {
			current.resolvedCount++
			if current.resolved.IsZero() || task.Resolved.After(current.resolved) {
				current.resolved = task.Resolved
			}
		} else if task.Status != "template" {
			current.taskCount++
		}
		if task.Status == "active" {
			current.active = true
		}
	}
	names := make([]string, 0, len(projects))
	for name := range projects {
		names = append(names, name)
	}
	sort.Slice(names, func(i, j int) bool {
		ai := projects[names[i]]
		aj := projects[names[j]]
		if !ai.created.Equal(aj.created) {
			return ai.created.Before(aj.created)
		}
		return names[i] < names[j]
	})
	out := make([]projectOutput, 0, len(names))
	for _, name := range names {
		project := projects[name]
		out = append(out, projectOutput{
			Name:          project.name,
			TaskCount:     project.taskCount,
			ResolvedCount: project.resolvedCount,
			Active:        project.active,
			Created:       formatTimestamp(project.created),
			Resolved:      formatTimestamp(project.resolved),
			Priority:      project.priority,
		})
	}
	printJSON(out)
	return 0
}

func commandAddLike(repo *Repository, mode string, args []string, ignoreContext bool) int {
	spec, err := parseCreateSpec(args)
	if err != nil {
		printError(err.Error())
		return 1
	}
	if spec.Summary == "" && spec.TemplateID == 0 {
		printError("task description or template required")
		return 1
	}
	var base *Task
	if spec.TemplateID != 0 {
		base = findTemplateByID(repo.Tasks, spec.TemplateID)
		if base == nil {
			printError(fmt.Sprintf("no template with ID %d exists", spec.TemplateID))
			return 1
		}
	}
	if !ignoreContext {
		printContextBanner(repo, true)
	}
	status := "pending"
	resolved := false
	action := "Added"
	commitFmt := "Added %d: %s"
	if mode == "log" {
		status = "resolved"
		resolved = true
		action = "Logged"
	}
	task, err := buildCreatedTask(base, spec, repo.Context, ignoreContext, status, resolved)
	if err != nil {
		printError(err.Error())
		return 1
	}
	task.UUID = newUUID()
	task.ID = nextAvailableIDFromMap(repo.IDs)
	repo.IDs[task.UUID] = task.ID
	repo.Tasks = append(repo.Tasks, task)
	if err := saveTask(repo.Path, task); err != nil {
		printError(err.Error())
		return 1
	}
	if err := saveIDs(repo.Path, repo.IDs); err != nil {
		printError(err.Error())
		return 1
	}

	var actionLine, commitMessage string
	if mode == "log" {
		actionLine = fmt.Sprintf("Logged %s", task.Summary)
		commitMessage = fmt.Sprintf("Logged %s", task.Summary)
	} else {
		actionLine = fmt.Sprintf("%s %d: %s", action, task.ID, task.Summary)
		commitMessage = fmt.Sprintf(commitFmt, task.ID, task.Summary)
	}
	fmt.Printf("\n%s\n", actionLine)
	return commitTask(repo.Path, commitMessage)
}

func commandTemplate(repo *Repository, before, after []string, ignoreContext bool) int {
	beforeIDs, _ := splitLeadingInts(before)
	afterIDs, rest := splitLeadingInts(after)
	var sourceID int
	switch {
	case len(beforeIDs) > 0:
		sourceID = beforeIDs[0]
	case len(afterIDs) > 0:
		sourceID = afterIDs[0]
	}
	spec, err := parseCreateSpec(rest)
	if err != nil {
		printError(err.Error())
		return 1
	}
	var base *Task
	if sourceID != 0 {
		base = findOpenOrTemplateByID(repo.Tasks, sourceID)
		if base == nil {
			printError(fmt.Sprintf("no open task with ID %d exists", sourceID))
			return 1
		}
	}
	if base == nil && spec.Summary == "" {
		printError("task description required")
		return 1
	}
	if !ignoreContext {
		printContextBanner(repo, true)
	}
	task, err := buildCreatedTask(base, spec, repo.Context, ignoreContext, "template", false)
	if err != nil {
		printError(err.Error())
		return 1
	}
	task.UUID = newUUID()
	task.ID = nextAvailableIDFromMap(repo.IDs)
	repo.IDs[task.UUID] = task.ID
	repo.Tasks = append(repo.Tasks, task)
	if err := saveTask(repo.Path, task); err != nil {
		printError(err.Error())
		return 1
	}
	if err := saveIDs(repo.Path, repo.IDs); err != nil {
		printError(err.Error())
		return 1
	}
	fmt.Printf("\nCreated Template %d: %s\n", task.ID, task.Summary)
	return commitTask(repo.Path, fmt.Sprintf("Created Template %d: %s", task.ID, task.Summary))
}

func commandStart(repo *Repository, before, after []string, ignoreContext bool) int {
	beforeIDs, _ := splitLeadingInts(before)
	afterIDs, rest := splitLeadingInts(after)
	if len(beforeIDs) > 0 || (len(afterIDs) > 0 && len(rest) == 0) {
		ids := append(beforeIDs, afterIDs...)
		if len(ids) == 0 {
			printError("nothing to do -- specify an ID or describe a task")
			return 1
		}
		for _, id := range ids {
			task := findOpenTaskByID(repo.Tasks, id)
			if task == nil {
				printError(fmt.Sprintf("no open task with ID %d exists", id))
				return 1
			}
			fmt.Printf("\nStarted %d: %s\n", task.ID, task.Summary)
			if task.Status == "active" {
				printGrayLine("No changes detected")
				continue
			}
			if task.Status == "resolved" || task.Status == "template" {
				printError(fmt.Sprintf("no open task with ID %d exists", id))
				return 1
			}
			oldStatus := task.Status
			task.Status = "active"
			if err := moveTaskFile(repo.Path, task, oldStatus, task.Status); err != nil {
				printError(err.Error())
				return 1
			}
			if code := commitTask(repo.Path, fmt.Sprintf("Started %d: %s", task.ID, task.Summary)); code != 0 {
				return code
			}
		}
		return 0
	}

	spec, err := parseCreateSpec(after)
	if err != nil {
		printError(err.Error())
		return 1
	}
	if spec.Summary == "" && spec.TemplateID == 0 {
		printError("nothing to do -- specify an ID or describe a task")
		return 1
	}
	var base *Task
	if spec.TemplateID != 0 {
		base = findTemplateByID(repo.Tasks, spec.TemplateID)
		if base == nil {
			printError(fmt.Sprintf("no template with ID %d exists", spec.TemplateID))
			return 1
		}
	}
	if !ignoreContext {
		printContextBanner(repo, true)
	}
	task, err := buildCreatedTask(base, spec, repo.Context, ignoreContext, "active", false)
	if err != nil {
		printError(err.Error())
		return 1
	}
	task.UUID = newUUID()
	task.ID = nextAvailableIDFromMap(repo.IDs)
	repo.IDs[task.UUID] = task.ID
	repo.Tasks = append(repo.Tasks, task)
	if err := saveTask(repo.Path, task); err != nil {
		printError(err.Error())
		return 1
	}
	if err := saveIDs(repo.Path, repo.IDs); err != nil {
		printError(err.Error())
		return 1
	}
	fmt.Printf("\nAdded and started %d: %s\n", task.ID, task.Summary)
	return commitTask(repo.Path, fmt.Sprintf("Added and started %d: %s", task.ID, task.Summary))
}

func commandStop(repo *Repository, before, after []string) int {
	beforeIDs, _ := splitLeadingInts(before)
	afterIDs, rest := splitLeadingInts(after)
	ids := append(beforeIDs, afterIDs...)
	if len(ids) == 0 {
		printError("no ID(s) specified")
		return 1
	}
	note := strings.Join(rest, " ")
	for _, id := range ids {
		task := findOpenTaskByID(repo.Tasks, id)
		if task == nil {
			printError(fmt.Sprintf("no open task with ID %d exists", id))
			return 1
		}
		if task.Status == "pending" {
			printError("invalid state transition: pending -> paused")
			return 1
		}
		fmt.Printf("\nStopped %d: %s\n", task.ID, task.Summary)
		changed := false
		if note != "" {
			task.Notes = appendNote(task.Notes, note)
			changed = true
		}
		if task.Status == "active" {
			oldStatus := task.Status
			task.Status = "paused"
			if err := moveTaskFile(repo.Path, task, oldStatus, task.Status); err != nil {
				printError(err.Error())
				return 1
			}
			changed = true
		} else if note != "" {
			if err := saveTask(repo.Path, task); err != nil {
				printError(err.Error())
				return 1
			}
		}
		if !changed {
			printGrayLine("No changes detected")
			continue
		}
		if task.Status == "paused" && note != "" && !fileExists(taskPath(repo.Path, "paused", task.UUID)) {
			if err := saveTask(repo.Path, task); err != nil {
				printError(err.Error())
				return 1
			}
		}
		if task.Status == "paused" && note != "" && fileExists(taskPath(repo.Path, "paused", task.UUID)) {
			if err := saveTask(repo.Path, task); err != nil {
				printError(err.Error())
				return 1
			}
		}
		if code := commitTask(repo.Path, fmt.Sprintf("Stopped %d: %s", task.ID, task.Summary)); code != 0 {
			return code
		}
	}
	return 0
}

func parseCreateSpec(args []string) (createSpec, error) {
	spec := createSpec{}
	summaryTokens := make([]string, 0, len(args))
	noteMode := false
	noteTokens := []string{}
	for _, arg := range args {
		if arg == "/" {
			noteMode = true
			continue
		}
		if noteMode {
			noteTokens = append(noteTokens, arg)
			continue
		}
		switch {
		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "template:"):
			id, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "template:"))
			if err == nil {
				spec.TemplateID = id
			}
		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "+") && len(arg) > 1:
			spec.Tags = append(spec.Tags, arg[1:])
		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "project:"):
			spec.HasProject = true
			spec.Project = strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "project:")
		case isPriority(arg):
			spec.Priority = arg
		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "due:"):
			ts, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "due:"))
			if err == nil {
				spec.Due = ts.UTC()
				spec.HasDue = true
			} else {
				summaryTokens = append(summaryTokens, arg)
			}
		default:
			summaryTokens = append(summaryTokens, arg)
		}
	}
	spec.Summary = strings.Join(summaryTokens, " ")
	spec.Note = strings.Join(noteTokens, " ")
	return spec, nil
}

func parseModifySpec(args []string) (modifySpec, error) {
	spec := modifySpec{}
	for _, arg := range args {
		switch {
		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "+") && len(arg) > 1:
			spec.AddTags = append(spec.AddTags, arg[1:])
		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-project:"):
			spec.ClearProject = strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "-project:")
		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") && len(arg) > 1:
			spec.RemoveTags = append(spec.RemoveTags, arg[1:])
		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "project:"):
			value := strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "project:")
			spec.SetProject = &value
		case isPriority(arg):
			value := arg
			spec.Priority = &value
		}
	}
	if len(spec.AddTags) == 0 && len(spec.RemoveTags) == 0 && spec.SetProject == nil && spec.ClearProject == "" && spec.Priority == nil {
		return modifySpec{}, errors.New("no operations specified")
	}
	return spec, nil
}

func parseFilter(args []string) Query {
	query := Query{}
	textParts := []string{}
	for _, arg := range args {
		switch {
		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "+") && len(arg) > 1:
			query.Tags = append(query.Tags, arg[1:])
		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-project:"):
			query.AntiProjects = append(query.AntiProjects, strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "-project:"))
		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") && len(arg) > 1:
			query.AntiTags = append(query.AntiTags, arg[1:])
		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "project:"):
			query.Project = strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "project:")
		case strings.HasPrefix(arg, "due:"):
			if ts, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "due:")); err == nil {
				query.Due = ts.UTC()
			} else {
				textParts = append(textParts, arg)
			}
		case isPriority(arg):
			query.Priority = arg
		default:
			textParts = append(textParts, arg)
		}
	}
	query.Text = strings.Join(textParts, " ")
	return query
}

func rawFields(value string) []string {
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(strings.NewReader(value))
	scanner.Split(bufio.ScanWords)
	var fields []string
	for scanner.Scan() {
		fields = append(fields, scanner.Text())
	}
	return fields
}

func buildCreatedTask(base *Task, spec createSpec, ctx Query, ignoreContext bool, status string, resolved bool) (*Task, error) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	task := &Task{
		Summary:      "",
		Notes:        "",
		Tags:         []string{},
		Project:      "",
		Priority:     "P2",
		DelegatedTo:  "",
		Subtasks:     []string{},
		Dependencies: []string{},
		Created:      now,
		Resolved:     time.Time{},
		Due:          time.Time{},
		Status:       status,
	}
	if base != nil {
		task.Summary = base.Summary
		task.Notes = base.Notes
		task.Tags = append([]string(nil), base.Tags...)
		task.Project = base.Project
		task.Priority = base.Priority
		task.Due = base.Due
		task.Subtasks = append([]string(nil), base.Subtasks...)
		task.Dependencies = append([]string(nil), base.Dependencies...)
	}
	if spec.Summary != "" {
		task.Summary = spec.Summary
	}
	if spec.Note != "" {
		if task.Notes == "" {
			task.Notes = spec.Note
		} else {
			task.Notes = appendNote(task.Notes, spec.Note)
		}
	}
	if task.Summary == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("task description required")
	}
	if spec.HasProject {
		task.Project = spec.Project
	}
	if spec.Priority != "" {
		task.Priority = spec.Priority
	}
	if spec.HasDue {
		task.Due = spec.Due
	}
	task.Tags = unionStrings(task.Tags, spec.Tags...)
	if !ignoreContext {
		if ctx.Project != "" {
			if task.Project == "" {
				task.Project = ctx.Project
			} else if task.Project != ctx.Project {
				return nil, errors.New("Could not apply q2, project conflict")
			}
		}
		task.Tags = unionStrings(task.Tags, ctx.Tags...)
	}
	task.Tags = uniqueStrings(task.Tags)
	if resolved {
		task.Resolved = now
	}
	return task, nil
}

func applyModifySpec(task *Task, spec modifySpec) bool {
	changed := false
	originalTags := append([]string(nil), task.Tags...)
	task.Tags = uniqueStrings(task.Tags)
	for _, tag := range spec.AddTags {
		if !contains(task.Tags, tag) {
			task.Tags = append(task.Tags, tag)
			changed = true
		}
	}
	for _, tag := range spec.RemoveTags {
		before := len(task.Tags)
		task.Tags = removeString(task.Tags, tag)
		if len(task.Tags) != before {
			changed = true
		}
	}
	if spec.SetProject != nil && task.Project != *spec.SetProject {
		task.Project = *spec.SetProject
		changed = true
	}
	if spec.ClearProject != "" && task.Project == spec.ClearProject {
		task.Project = ""
		changed = true
	}
	if spec.Priority != nil && task.Priority != *spec.Priority {
		task.Priority = *spec.Priority
		changed = true
	}
	if !changed && strings.Join(originalTags, "\x00") != strings.Join(task.Tags, "\x00") {
		changed = true
	}
	return changed
}

func renderTasks(repo *Repository, tasks []*Task, name string) int {
	if name == "show-tags" {
		return 0
	}
	if !repo.Human {
		out := make([]outputTask, 0, len(tasks))
		for _, task := range tasks {
			out = append(out, toOutputTask(task))
		}
		printJSON(out)
		return 0
	}

	if repo.ContextString != "" && name != "show-resolved" && name != "show-tags" && name != "show-projects" {
		if repo.ContextFromEnv {
			fmt.Printf("%sActive context (set by DSTASK_CONTEXT): %s%s\n", colorYellow, repo.ContextString, colorReset)
		} else {
			fmt.Printf("%sActive context: %s%s\n", colorYellow, repo.ContextString, colorReset)
		}
	}

	if len(tasks) == 0 {
		fmt.Println("No tasks found. Run `dstask help` for instructions.")
		return 0
	}
	if name == "show-resolved" {
		renderResolvedHuman(tasks)
		return 0
	}
	if len(tasks) == 1 {
		renderTaskDetail(tasks[0])
		return 0
	}
	renderTaskTable(tasks)
	return 0
}

func renderTaskTable(tasks []*Task) {
	fmt.Printf("%s%-3s %-8s %-4s %-3s %-7s %-15s%s\n", colorHeader, "ID", "Priority", "Tags", "Due", "Project", "Summary", colorReset)
	for i, task := range tasks {
		color := rowColor(task, i)
		fmt.Printf("%s%-3d %-8s %-4s %-3s %-7s %-15s%s\n",
			color,
			task.ID,
			task.Priority,
			truncate(joinTags(task.Tags), 4),
			shortDate(task.Due),
			truncate(task.Project, 7),
			truncate(task.Summary, 15),
			colorReset,
		)
	}
	fmt.Printf("\n%d tasks.\n", len(tasks))
}

func renderTaskDetail(task *Task) {
	fmt.Printf("%s%-9s %-39s%s\n", colorHeader, "Name", "Value", colorReset)
	rows := [][2]string{
		{"ID", strconv.Itoa(task.ID)},
		{"Priority", task.Priority},
		{"Summary", task.Summary},
		{"Status", task.Status},
		{"Project", task.Project},
		{"Tags", joinTags(task.Tags)},
		{"UUID", task.UUID},
		{"Created", task.Created.UTC().String()},
	}
	if !task.Due.IsZero() {
		rows = append(rows, [2]string{"Due", task.Due.UTC().String()})
	}
	if !task.Resolved.IsZero() {
		rows = append(rows, [2]string{"Resolved", task.Resolved.UTC().String()})
	}
	for i, row := range rows {
		bg := 233
		if i%2 == 1 {
			bg = 232
		}
		fmt.Printf("\x1b[0;38;5;250;48;5;%dm%-9s %-39s%s\n", bg, row[0], truncate(row[1], 39), colorReset)
	}
	if task.Notes != "" {
		fmt.Printf("\nNotes on task %d:\n", task.ID)
		fmt.Printf("%s%s%s\n\n", colorGray, task.Notes, colorReset)
	}
}

func rowColor(task *Task, index int) string {
	switch task.Status {
	case "active":
		return "\x1b[0;38;5;233;48;5;250m"
	case "paused":
		return "\x1b[0;38;5;250;48;5;236m"
	}
	bg := 233
	if index%2 == 1 {
		bg = 232
	}
	fg := 250
	switch task.Priority {
	case "P0":
		fg = 160
	case "P1":
		fg = 166
	case "P2":
		fg = 250
	case "P3":
		fg = 245
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("\x1b[0;38;5;%d;48;5;%dm", fg, bg)
}

func applyContextAndFilter(repo *Repository, tasks []*Task, query Query, useContext bool) []*Task {
	result := make([]*Task, 0, len(tasks))
	for _, task := range tasks {
		if useContext && !matchesQuery(task, repo.Context) {
			continue
		}
		if !matchesQuery(task, query) {
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, task)
	}
	return result
}

func matchesQuery(task *Task, query Query) bool {
	for _, tag := range query.Tags {
		if !contains(task.Tags, tag) {
			return false
		}
	}
	for _, tag := range query.AntiTags {
		if contains(task.Tags, tag) {
			return false
		}
	}
	if query.Project != "" && task.Project != query.Project {
		return false
	}
	for _, project := range query.AntiProjects {
		if task.Project == project {
			return false
		}
	}
	if query.Priority != "" && task.Priority != query.Priority {
		return false
	}
	if !query.Due.IsZero() && !task.Due.Equal(query.Due) {
		return false
	}
	if query.Text != "" {
		needle := strings.ToLower(query.Text)
		haystack := strings.ToLower(task.Summary + "\n" + task.Notes)
		if !strings.Contains(haystack, needle) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func sortTasksForView(tasks []*Task, name string) {
	switch name {
	case "show-resolved":
		sort.Slice(tasks, func(i, j int) bool {
			if !tasks[i].Resolved.Equal(tasks[j].Resolved) {
				return tasks[i].Resolved.Before(tasks[j].Resolved)
			}
			if !tasks[i].Created.Equal(tasks[j].Created) {
				return tasks[i].Created.Before(tasks[j].Created)
			}
			return tasks[i].UUID < tasks[j].UUID
		})
	default:
		sort.Slice(tasks, func(i, j int) bool {
			pi := priorityRank(tasks[i].Priority)
			pj := priorityRank(tasks[j].Priority)
			if pi != pj {
				return pi < pj
			}
			if !tasks[i].Created.Equal(tasks[j].Created) {
				return tasks[i].Created.Before(tasks[j].Created)
			}
			if strings.ToLower(tasks[i].Summary) != strings.ToLower(tasks[j].Summary) {
				return strings.ToLower(tasks[i].Summary) < strings.ToLower(tasks[j].Summary)
			}
			return tasks[i].UUID < tasks[j].UUID
		})
	}
}

func priorityRank(priority string) int {
	switch priority {
	case "P0":
		return 0
	case "P1":
		return 1
	case "P2":
		return 2
	case "P3":
		return 3
	default:
		return 2
	}
}

func toOutputTask(task *Task) outputTask {
	return outputTask{
		UUID:     task.UUID,
		Status:   task.Status,
		ID:       task.ID,
		Summary:  task.Summary,
		Notes:    task.Notes,
		Tags:     append([]string(nil), task.Tags...),
		Project:  task.Project,
		Priority: task.Priority,
		Created:  formatTimestamp(task.Created),
		Resolved: formatTimestamp(task.Resolved),
		Due:      formatTimestamp(task.Due),
	}
}

func formatTimestamp(ts time.Time) string {
	if ts.IsZero() {
		return "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z"
	}
	return ts.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
}

func tasksByStatuses(tasks []*Task, statuses ...string) []*Task {
	allowed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, status := range statuses {
		allowed[status] = true
	}
	result := make([]*Task, 0, len(tasks))
	for _, task := range tasks {
		if allowed[task.Status] {
			result = append(result, task)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func filterByIDs(tasks []*Task, ids []int, requireMap bool) []*Task {
	set := map[int]bool{}
	for _, id := range ids {
		set[id] = true
	}
	result := make([]*Task, 0, len(ids))
	for _, task := range tasks {
		if set[task.ID] {
			result = append(result, task)
		}
	}
	_ = requireMap
	return result
}

func findOpenTaskByID(tasks []*Task, id int) *Task {
	for _, task := range tasks {
		if task.ID == id && (task.Status == "pending" || task.Status == "active" || task.Status == "paused") {
			return task
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func findOpenOrTemplateByID(tasks []*Task, id int) *Task {
	for _, task := range tasks {
		if task.ID == id && (task.Status == "pending" || task.Status == "active" || task.Status == "paused" || task.Status == "template") {
			return task
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func findTemplateByID(tasks []*Task, id int) *Task {
	for _, task := range tasks {
		if task.ID == id && task.Status == "template" {
			return task
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func saveTask(repo string, task *Task) error {
	dir := filepath.Join(repo, task.Status)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, task.UUID+".yml"), []byte(encodeTaskYAML(task)), 0o644)
}

func moveTaskFile(repo string, task *Task, fromStatus, toStatus string) error {
	from := taskPath(repo, fromStatus, task.UUID)
	to := taskPath(repo, toStatus, task.UUID)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(to), 0o755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if fromStatus == toStatus {
		return os.WriteFile(to, []byte(encodeTaskYAML(task)), 0o644)
	}
	if err := os.Rename(from, to); err != nil {
		if err := os.WriteFile(to, []byte(encodeTaskYAML(task)), 0o644); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_ = os.Remove(from)
	} else {
		if err := os.WriteFile(to, []byte(encodeTaskYAML(task)), 0o644); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func taskPath(repo, status, uuid string) string {
	return filepath.Join(repo, status, uuid+".yml")
}

func encodeTaskYAML(task *Task) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	writeYAMLLine(&b, "summary", task.Summary)
	if strings.Contains(task.Notes, "\n") {
		b.WriteString("notes: |2-\n")
		for _, line := range strings.Split(task.Notes, "\n") {
			b.WriteString("\n  ")
			b.WriteString(line)
		}
		b.WriteString("\n")
	} else {
		writeYAMLLine(&b, "notes", task.Notes)
	}
	writeYAMLArray(&b, "tags", task.Tags)
	writeYAMLLine(&b, "project", task.Project)
	b.WriteString("priority: ")
	b.WriteString(task.Priority)
	b.WriteString("\n")
	writeYAMLLine(&b, "delegatedto", task.DelegatedTo)
	writeYAMLArray(&b, "subtasks", task.Subtasks)
	writeYAMLArray(&b, "dependencies", task.Dependencies)
	b.WriteString("created: ")
	b.WriteString(formatTimestamp(task.Created))
	b.WriteString("\n")
	b.WriteString("resolved: ")
	b.WriteString(formatTimestamp(task.Resolved))
	b.WriteString("\n")
	b.WriteString("due: ")
	b.WriteString(formatTimestamp(task.Due))
	b.WriteString("\n")
	return b.String()
}

func writeYAMLLine(b *strings.Builder, key, value string) {
	b.WriteString(key)
	b.WriteString(": ")
	b.WriteString(yamlScalar(value))
	b.WriteString("\n")
}

func writeYAMLArray(b *strings.Builder, key string, values []string) {
	if len(values) == 0 {
		b.WriteString(key)
		b.WriteString(": []\n")
		return
	}
	b.WriteString(key)
	b.WriteString(":\n")
	for _, value := range values {
		b.WriteString("- ")
		b.WriteString(yamlScalar(value))
		b.WriteString("\n")
	}
}

func yamlScalar(value string) string {
	if value == "" {
		return `""`
	}
	if shouldQuoteYAML(value) {
		return strconv.Quote(value)
	}
	return value
}

func shouldQuoteYAML(value string) bool {
	lower := strings.ToLower(value)
	switch lower {
	case "y", "yes", "n", "no", "true", "false", "on", "off", "null", "~":
		return true
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(value, " ") || strings.HasSuffix(value, " ") {
		return true
	}
	if strings.ContainsAny(value, `":{}[],&*#?|<>=!%@\`) {
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func commitTask(repo, message string) int {
	return commitTaskMode(repo, message, false)
}

func commitTaskQuiet(repo, message string) int {
	return commitTaskMode(repo, message, true)
}

func commitTaskMode(repo, message string, quietAction bool) int {
	if err := gitStageAll(repo); err != nil {
		printGrayOutput(err.Error() + "\n")
		printError(fmt.Sprintf("error: failed to commit changes: %v", err))
		return 1
	}
	changed, err := gitHasChanges(repo)
	if err != nil {
		printGrayOutput(err.Error() + "\n")
		printError(fmt.Sprintf("error: failed to commit changes: %v", err))
		return 1
	}
	if !changed {
		if !quietAction {
			printGrayLine("No changes detected")
		}
		return 0
	}
	out, err := gitCombined(repo, "commit", "-m", message)
	printGrayOutput(out)
	if err != nil {
		printError(fmt.Sprintf("error: failed to commit changes: %v", err))
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

func gitStageAll(repo string) error {
	_, err := gitCombined(repo, "add", "-A")
	return err
}

func gitHasChanges(repo string) (bool, error) {
	out, err := gitCombined(repo, "status", "--porcelain")
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(out) != "", nil
}

func gitCombined(repo string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	cmd := exec.Command("git", append([]string{"-C", repo}, args...)...)
	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	return string(out), err
}

func readConfirmation(r io.Reader) (bool, error) {
	reader := bufio.NewReader(r)
	line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	answer := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(line))
	return answer == "y" || answer == "yes", nil
}

func printJSON(v any) {
	data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
	fmt.Println(string(data))
}

func printError(msg string) {
	fmt.Printf("%s%s%s\n", colorRed, msg, colorReset)
}

func printGrayLine(msg string) {
	fmt.Printf("%s%s\n%s", colorGray, msg, colorReset)
}

func printGrayOutput(out string) {
	if out == "" {
		return
	}
	fmt.Print(colorGray)
	fmt.Print(out)
	fmt.Print(colorReset)
}

func printContextBanner(repo *Repository, blankLine bool) {
	if repo.ContextString == "" {
		return
	}
	if repo.ContextFromEnv {
		fmt.Printf("%sActive context (set by DSTASK_CONTEXT): %s%s\n", colorYellow, repo.ContextString, colorReset)
	} else {
		fmt.Printf("%sActive context: %s%s\n", colorYellow, repo.ContextString, colorReset)
	}
	if blankLine {
		fmt.Println()
	}
}

func nextAvailableIDFromMap(ids IdsMap) int {
	used := map[int]bool{}
	for _, id := range ids {
		if id > 0 {
			used[id] = true
		}
	}
	return nextAvailableID(used)
}

func appendNote(existing, addition string) string {
	if addition == "" {
		return existing
	}
	return existing + "\n" + addition
}

func unionStrings(base []string, extras ...string) []string {
	result := append([]string(nil), base...)
	for _, extra := range extras {
		if extra == "" {
			continue
		}
		if !contains(result, extra) {
			result = append(result, extra)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func uniqueStrings(values []string) []string {
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		if value == "" || seen[value] {
			continue
		}
		seen[value] = true
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return result
}

func removeString(values []string, target string) []string {
	result := values[:0]
	for _, value := range values {
		if value != target {
			result = append(result, value)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func contains(values []string, target string) bool {
	for _, value := range values {
		if value == target {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func joinTags(tags []string) string {
	return strings.Join(tags, ",")
}

func truncate(value string, limit int) string {
	if limit <= 0 {
		return ""
	}
	runes := []rune(value)
	if len(runes) <= limit {
		return value
	}
	return string(runes[:limit])
}

func shortDate(ts time.Time) string {
	if ts.IsZero() {
		return ""
	}
	return ts.Format("2 Jan")
}

func isoWeek(ts time.Time) int {
	_, week := ts.ISOWeek()
	return week
}

func isPriority(value string) bool {
	return value == "P0" || value == "P1" || value == "P2" || value == "P3"
}

func splitLeadingInts(values []string) ([]int, []string) {
	var ids []int
	index := 0
	for index < len(values) {
		id, err := strconv.Atoi(values[index])
		if err != nil {
			break
		}
		ids = append(ids, id)
		index++
	}
	return ids, values[index:]
}

func parseInts(values []string) []int {
	var ids []int
	for _, value := range values {
		if id, err := strconv.Atoi(value); err == nil {
			ids = append(ids, id)
		}
	}
	return ids
}

func allInts(values []string) bool {
	if len(values) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	for _, value := range values {
		if _, err := strconv.Atoi(value); err != nil {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func isHumanOutput() bool {
	if os.Getenv("DSTASK_FAKE_PTY") == "1" {
		return true
	}
	info, err := os.Stdout.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return (info.Mode() & os.ModeCharDevice) != 0
}

func queryString(q Query) string {
	parts := []string{}
	for _, tag := range q.Tags {
		parts = append(parts, "+"+tag)
	}
	for _, tag := range q.AntiTags {
		parts = append(parts, "-"+tag)
	}
	if q.Project != "" {
		parts = append(parts, "project:"+q.Project)
	}
	for _, project := range q.AntiProjects {
		parts = append(parts, "-project:"+project)
	}
	if q.Priority != "" {
		parts = append(parts, q.Priority)
	}
	if !q.Due.IsZero() {
		parts = append(parts, "due:"+q.Due.Format("2006-01-02"))
	}
	if q.Text != "" {
		parts = append(parts, q.Text)
	}
	return strings.Join(parts, " ")
}

func newUUID() string {
	var b [16]byte
	_, _ = rand.Read(b[:])
	b[6] = (b[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40
	b[8] = (b[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80
	return fmt.Sprintf("%08x-%04x-%04x-%04x-%012x",
		b[0:4],
		b[4:6],
		b[6:8],
		b[8:10],
		b[10:16],
	)
}

func fileExists(path string) bool {
	_, err := os.Stat(path)
	return err == nil
}
